name: Genesis
about: Genesis (2001-034A, NASA/JPL), launched 2001 Aug  8. Its phases from GCAT: SEL1, Earth, SEL2, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
about the Sun-Earth L1 point, about 1.5 million km sunward of the Earth: shown as an orbit like the Earth's, 1% inside, with the halo or Lissajous loop left out
GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
about the Sun-Earth L2 point, about 1.5 million km beyond the Earth: shown as an orbit like the Earth's, 1% outside, with the halo or Lissajous loop left out
GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
